BiblicalUsage: Deuel is the father of Eliasaph, prince of the tribe of Gad, named in the numbering, the offerings, and the march of the camp. His name appears where the tribes are counted and ordered for the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse honours the fathers behind the princes: the tribe is named by its father, and the father by his son.
